name: Focal target push and rotate
summary: Scale and rotate while compensating position so a chosen point converges toward frame centre.
creativeJobs: direct the eye to a specific subject
add unease with a slow canted move
mediaPrerequisites: a confirmed normalized target point inside the displayed media
refusalConditions: target point unconfirmed — a zoom toward centre is a different effect from the one requested
requested duration exceeds an admitted movie source duration
qualityChecks: the target point actually converges toward centre across the move
rotation direction matches intent — positive Final Cut rotation is counterclockwise
no source edge enters frame at the widest point of the move
failureModes: defaulting an unconfirmed target to centre, which silently ignores the request
sign error on the vertical axis sending the move the wrong way
rotation large enough to expose frame corners

riskGates.basis: A confirmed normalized target and admitted transform channels bound the construction.

safetyGates.basis: Target confirmation and exact channel validation are required at admission.

provenance.claim: Final Cut animates transform parameters with keyframes
rotation is a single param in plain degrees; anchor is a paired attribute; movie keyframes start at 0s rather than the stills 3600s origin
the generated rotation, scale and compensating position track is admitted and the rotation keyframe is editable

verifiedOn: user-supplied dali.jpeg with a confirmed target
validation.notes: Rotation edited 12 to 30 degrees in the isolated app and returned as 30 with scale, position and keyframe count unchanged.

notes: Targeting is done by position compensation rather than by moving the anchor, because animated position is observed and an animated anchor is not.
safety: Review the result on representative media before use.
